title.label: Nice idea. False Advertising on Social Media

content.label:
This app is a very diverse and overly complicated timer for the Pomodoro Technique. Instead of helping my ADHD, I get so lost setting a timer, timing the sound and figuring out the warm up and post focus period times that this app makes me significantly less productive. 

The lack of the 8D audio files with vocals that are used in ads are not on the app, and the sounds in the 8D category of the app don’t alternate in my headphones to produce the focusing effect like the ad suggested. I missed canceling my 7 day trial by 12 hours and am stuck with this ineffective, over priced service for 3 months. I want my $64 returned.

NOT FINDING “the amazing experience” the ads use as an example or they suggest are part of the app.  The ad with the guy standing with a slanted ceiling behind him, with the sound of a woman’s voice singing without music, and it goes from ear to ear…where is that song/singing in the app???!! Two times now, I can’t find what your ads suggest are in the app.
Endel confirmed in email that specific songs heard in the ads AREN’T available in the app.  They need to disclose that in ALL ads.  Otherwise it’s flat out deceptive.

App is marketed with 8D audio that has words but there is nothing with words.. If you pause the sound or the sound is paused due to a call, it won’t resume unless you close out and start over.

Endel responded to my review: 

"This song is not present in the Endel app. It is used in that video to demonstrate the 8D effect you can hear in the 8D Odyssey soundscape in the Endel app. Sorry for the ambiguity!"

This isn’t ambiguity it’s false advertising. I’ve seen multiple adds, both with words. Maybe mention in the add that the app doesn’t actually have words.. if I missed this, my bad.

title.label: Great for sleeping, energy at work and more

content.label:
Our daughter discovered Endel and shared it with me.  I was initially unsure what this was about, but once I heard the White Noise and the Sleep settings I was sold.  

I have found the Uplift setting is good for additional energy, particular at work.  

Focus lives up to its name... especially when I have a lengthy list of tasks to complete - I turn on Focus - - with iPhone, AirPods or the Bluetooth speaker - -  and I can somehow focus on one or two items at a time.  The Focus setting has greatly reduced my stress levels.

Deeper Focus is awesome… listening to this I can get A LOT done with energy… often toe-tapping while I type.

I now use the Sleep setting each night; falling asleep to the waves and other noise is so peaceful, but it’s the wake up that is impressive… Endel’s sound starts softly and gradually increases, and it is peaceful-to-energetic at just the right pace to get you moving and not roll back over.

It’s great that the app is something you can use on all your devices!

Thank you to all who make Endel so good!
